- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Numerology is described as a belief in the divine, mystical relationship between numbers and physical objects or living things.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is based on the idea that the universe and all of its parts are interconnected and can be understood through the study of numbers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Each number is believed to have its own unique energy and vibrations, which can be used to understand a person's personality, strengths, weaknesses, and predict their future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Numerology is often used in conjunction with astrology, tarot, and other forms of divination.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Numerology is not a scientifically recognized field of study, and practitioners do not claim to have scientific evidence to support their beliefs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some people find numerology useful for personal growth and self-improvement, while others view it as entertainment or superstition.
